# vault/avd_second_brain.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

AVD Second Brain -- turns collector and validator evidence packages into a living, Markdown knowledge base for an Azure Virtual Desktop estate.

The collector answers "what is here today?" and the validator answers "is it healthy?". Each run is a point in time. This script remembers them: it ingests evidence packages into a Git-friendly Markdown vault (Obsidian-compatible) and keeps, per subscription, - an overview page with the latest inventory and validator verdicts - a timeline of every run - drift notes: what was added, removed or changed between two inventory snapshots - a findings register: every validator FAIL / WARN with first-seen and last-seen dates, closed only when the same check later passes - condensed snapshots (Markdown to read, JSON for tooling) Alongside the generated notes the vault holds the knowledge people carry in their heads: decisions (ADRs), runbooks, lessons and a glossary. A runbook that declares `resolves-checks` in its front matter is linked from every matching finding. The vault holds real tenant data. Keep it in its own private repository: this script and the vault template live in avd-second-brain, the estate's knowledge lives there. Generalized knowledge flows back to avd-second-brain's knowledge base through a harvest (scripts/Get-VaultHarvest.ps1), and shared runbooks flow in at -Init. Personal project, not for production use. Provided as is, without warranty of any kind (MIT License, see LICENSE). Not affiliated with the author's employer, with Liquidware or with Microsoft. OFFLINE AND LOCAL ------------------------------------------------------------------ This script makes no Azure call and needs no Az module. It reads evidence packages and writes only inside -BrainPath. Raw evidence is not copied into the vault; only condensed facts are. Generated content is rebuilt on every ingest. Human text placed outside the `<!-- brain:generated:start -->` / `<!-- brain:generated:end -->` markers is kept.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-BrainPath` | string | yes |  | Folder of the vault. Usually the root of a private Git repository. |
| `-Init` | switch | no |  | Scaffolds the vault from the template. Existing files are never overwritten, so it is safe to run against a vault that already exists to pick up new template files. |
| `-PackagePath` | string[] | no | `@()` | One or more evidence packages to ingest: package folders, their ZIP archives, or a parent folder containing several. Collector and validator packages are told apart by their manifest. Packages are ingested oldest first whatever the order given. |
| `-Force` | switch | no |  | Re-ingest packages that were ingested before. |
| `-TemplatePath` | string | no | `(Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'template')` | Vault template. Defaults to template/ next to this script. |
| `-KnowledgePath` | string | no | `(Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'knowledge')` | The knowledge base whose shared runbooks -Init copies into the vault (never over an existing file). Defaults to knowledge/ in this repository. |

## Examples

```powershell
.\avd_second_brain.ps1 -BrainPath ..\avd-brain -Init
```
```powershell
.\avd_second_brain.ps1 -BrainPath ..\avd-brain -PackagePath .\avd-current-state-20261015T091500
```
```powershell
.\avd_second_brain.ps1 -BrainPath ..\avd-brain -PackagePath (Get-ChildItem .\avd-*.zip)
```
